Before I sign off, I want to follow our standard round-robin review. The current draft has 100 webhook requests per minute per tenant, 8 replay workers, 30-day payload body retention, and no targeted customer notice. I'd like reliability and customer success to state any final operational or customer commitments before we finalize. Who would like to go first?
